d:
Eeran ki islamik rivolyushanri gard kor yani aaeeaarjisi ne hal hi men naee misail siti batae ja rahe parisar ki tasviren jari kin. in tasviron men sashastr balon ke chiph oph janral staph ali abdullahi ko aaeeaarjisi eyrospes phors ke kamandar majid mausavi ke sath parisar ka daura karte hue bhi dikhe.
Apni naee misail siti ki tasviren jari kar eeran kya sandesh dena chahta hai? eeran ki naee misail siti kahe jane vale is kompleks ke bare men kya pata hai?
Aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat.
